annotations.title: Search JS Fingerprint By Normalized Hash

description: Look up JavaScript by normalized hash (computed after whitespace and formatting are removed, so reformatted copies still match) and report prevalence: total matches, unique scans, first and last seen and the matching scripts.

from_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01); omit for the API's default.
from_date.title: From Date

hash_value.description: Normalized hash of a JavaScript file: its hash after whitespace and formatting are removed.
hash_value.title: Hash Value

include_scans.description: Also list the scans in which the file appeared.
include_scans.title: Include Scans

to_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-12); omit for the API's default.
to_date.title: To Date

name: search_js_fingerprint_by_normalized_hash
title: Search JS Fingerprint By Normalized Hash
